clips.title: The story
paras: The Head of Arugal is the grisly trophy taken from the mad archmage atop Shadowfang Keep. Brought to the Forsaken at the Sepulcher, it serves as undeniable proof that the master of the local worgen has fallen.

Archmage Arugal has long cast a dark shadow across Silverpine Forest, commanding the lupine horrors from the ramparts of Shadowfang Keep. Claiming his severed head is the ultimate mandate given by Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher. To the Forsaken, the head is far more than a gruesome token; it signifies the removal of a potent spellcaster whose feral beasts impeded Lady Sylvanas's complete dominion over Silverpine. Presenting it to Dawnweaver confirms that the rogue archmage's foul sorcery has finally been severed from the land.
